name: decision-timeline
title: Decision Timeline
description: A plan recommendation that shows its actual math: four weighted factors, each with its own mute switch and a magnitude bar, sum to a live, tween-animated point total against a visible threshold. Mute the biggest factor and watch the recommendation genuinely flip, Pro to Starter, with a shared-layout sliding pill, not just a relabeled badge; this is real, inspectable arithmetic driving the outcome, not a canned explanation.
